LIVE_CHAT_RULES.DESCRIPTION: How long an agent has to reply before a waiting customer counts as overdue, how much time the extend action buys, and when idle conversations are resolved and closed automatically. Set a default for the account and override it for any project.

FORM.TITLE: Live chat rule
FORM.DESC: These values drive the countdown shown on every waiting conversation and the automatic resolve and close.

REPLY_TIMEOUT.LABEL: Reply within (minutes)
REPLY_TIMEOUT.HELP: Time an agent has to reply before the conversation counts as overdue. The countdown restarts whenever the customer writes again.

EXTENSION.LABEL: Extend adds (minutes)
EXTENSION.HELP: How much time the extend action adds to a single conversation.

WAITING_TIME.LABEL: Missed after (minutes)
WAITING_TIME.HELP: An open conversation that nobody is assigned to or replies to within this time counts as missed.

AUTO_SOLVE.LABEL: Resolve pending after (hours)
AUTO_SOLVE.HELP: A pending conversation the customer has not answered in this time is resolved automatically.

AUTO_CLOSE.LABEL: Close resolved after (hours)
AUTO_CLOSE.HELP: A resolved conversation is closed after this time and can no longer be replied to.

CHAT_LIMIT.LABEL: Chats per agent
CHAT_LIMIT.HELP: Most open, pending and snoozed conversations an agent can hold across the project. Auto-assignment skips an agent who is at the limit.

TRANSFER_TEAM.LABEL: Transfer team
TRANSFER_TEAM.HELP: Agents can transfer a conversation, with a reason, to a member of this team.

ASSISTED_WEIGHT.LABEL: Assisted weight
ASSISTED_WEIGHT.HELP: Points an agent earns in Agent productivity for each conversation they handled but someone else solved. A solve is worth 1.

TRANSFER_PENALTY.LABEL: General handover penalty
TRANSFER_PENALTY.HELP: Points taken off for each transfer with the reason General handover. Other reasons cost nothing.
